Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Ulel Zharor: 24-year-old woman, 179 cm (tall), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: heart-shaped face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; prominent bridge, compact mouth; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, medium-loose, deliberate accent: wrapped side section. Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: contrasting boot laces. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: low-maintenance grooming with highly polished footwear. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: chin remains level while one hand lightly checks a cuff seam. Include a polished seed case only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance.
